title: Annular Apron Corner
description: One newly authored static annular pavement corner with a genuine concave inner arc, 32 complete curved facets, a continuous 120 mm solid slab and two orthogonal 1.988 m radial end profiles. A separate complete 12 mm thick curved raised edge stripe has a full finite embedded root. The slab is 0 to 0.12 m high; the stripe top is 0.124 m. Eight-millimetre slab top/bottom bevels and 3 mm stripe bevels are explicitly modelled. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontally bounds-centred ground origin and two opaque constant unlinked PBR materials. Only two explicitly measured rigid placements of the exact pinned aviation-apron-tile-01 are in scope; their original 8 mm bevels and straight raised stripes are preserved, with nominal 12 mm slab joints and real stripe-end setbacks. Old neighbours exist only for QA and are never exported. This is newly authored annular geometry, not markings on a square tile or a recoloured solid soil-road sector. One modular game-visual asset; no aircraft, ground, scene, navigation, collision, airport marking standards, aviation operation, turning sweeps, aircraft suitability, loading, drainage, construction, manufacturing or safety certification is claimed. Joints and stripe interruptions are intentional; no seamlessness or general layout compatibility claim.
